_comment: Field type mapping rules for ICJIA public website Strapi 3 → 5. Direct mappings are passthrough; overrides handle source-shape mismatches; uploadPluginAllowedTypes is reference-only since allowedTypes are present in every .settings.json upload field.

overrides._comment: Empty for ICJIA — no Base64-string-as-image fields like the sibling tool's article.splash/thumbnail or app.image. Add entries here only if a source field type needs to change shape on the destination side.

uploadPluginAllowedTypes._comment: Reference of allowedTypes per content-type.field. Schema generator should read directly from .settings.json; this block exists for traceability and fallback.

incompleteRelations._comment: Source-side relations missing `via` and/or `dominant` flags. Phase 1 schema generator injects these defaults so Strapi 5 schemas are valid.
